findings.title: `include_website_name` is missing `?` and `:website_name` is not marked as an untrusted attribute
findings.body: `include_website_name` is defined without a trailing question mark, so ActiveModel::Serializer ignores it and always includes `website_name` in the serialized payload (even when `website` is blank, emitting `"website_name": null`). Furthermore, `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` (lines 105-111) so that TL0 users' websites are hidden from anonymous viewers (`scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)`), whereas `website_name` is not. As a result, a TL0 user's website domain/path is leaked to anonymous users via `website_name` even when `website` itself is suppressed. Rename the method to `include_website_name?` or add `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` (and remove the custom `include_website_name` method, since `untrusted_attributes` already checks `send(attr).present?`).

findings.title: `" ." << website_host` mutates a non-frozen string literal across calls in Ruby 2.x
findings.body: On line 149, `"." << website_host` uses the mutating shovel operator `<<` on the string literal `"."` instead of `+`. Unless `# frozen_string_literal: true` is active, Ruby evaluates the literal object and mutates it in place, or (if frozen in later Ruby versions) raises `FrozenError: can't modify frozen String`. Use `"." + website_host` or `"#{website_host}"` interpolation instead.

findings.title: `website_name` is not updated on the client after saving user preferences
findings.body: Previously, `websiteName` was a computed property on the controller derived from `model.website`, so editing and saving `website` in user preferences immediately updated the displayed website name on the user profile. Now `website_name` is only computed on the server in `UserSerializer`, and `User#save` (lines 206-214) only copies `bio_excerpt` from the PUT response back onto the model (`self.set('bio_excerpt', data.user.bio_excerpt)`). After a user updates their `website` in preferences and navigates back to their profile without a full page reload, `model.website_name` remains stale (or undefined if they didn't previously have one). `User#save` should also update `self.set('website_name', data.user.website_name)`.
